reason: The EC2 compose file does not forward AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK, so Bedrock API-key auth cannot work in the container: bedrock.provider.ts:361 reads that variable and the AWS SDK also reads it natively, but the environment block only passes AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Live symptom on the server: 'Bedrock select failed: Could not load credentials from any providers' with the token correctly present in deployment/ec2/.env. Also forward AWS_SESSION_TOKEN for temporary credentials, and add SEED_USERS so additional users survive a re-run of the migrate service.
